g.text: Actual kit photo + relay/pump breadboard connection
Photo: supplied product image (cropped); pin labels shown schematically, verify your physical part.
Pump power circuit (no breadboard motor current)
Flyback diode across pump: stripe → +; anode → −. NO only, never NC.
Logic side • breadboard transistor driver (only verified 5V active-LOW relay)
The actual 2N2222 pin order varies. Identify B/C/E before inserting; do not use this drawing as pin-order evidence.
First test relay only, then attach pump supply with power OFF. The motor current must not pass through breadboard.
